analysis.headline: Sells & Shares Your Data
analysis.quote: We also share information in ways that may be considered a sale of information under some state laws, such as exchanging subscriber lists for marketing or sharing identifiers and other information with non-AT&T advertising companies to target and deliver ads on behalf of advertisers, including AT&T.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: Location data is automatically generated when devices, products and services interact with cell towers and Wi-Fi routers. Location data can also be generated by Bluetooth services, network devices and other technology, including GPS satellites.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Web Browsing
analysis.quote: We automatically collect a variety of information, which may include time spent on websites or apps, website and IP addresses and advertising IDs, links and ads seen, videos watched, search terms entered, and items placed in online AT&T shopping carts.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric Data
analysis.quote: Biometric information. Fingerprints, voice prints, and face scans are examples of biological characteristics that may be used to identify individuals.

analysis.headline: Buys Third-Party Data
analysis.quote: We get information from outside sources like credit reports, marketing mailing lists, and commercially available demographic and geographic data.

analysis.headline: No Do Not Track Response
analysis.quote: We don’t currently respond to Do Not Track.

analysis.headline: You Can Appeal Denials
analysis.quote: And if we deny your request, you have the option to appeal our decision.

analysis.headline: Provides Data Sharing Chart
analysis.quote: This chart shows the personal information we shared or sold over the past year about at least some consumers.

analysis.headline: Uses AI for Decision-Making
analysis.quote: Uses automated decision-making, such as artificial intelligence.
